title: The Everseed Saga
logline: A tiny apple-headed homebody must carry a whispering golden seed-ring across a world of fruit-headed heroes and rotten horrors before the Charred King wakes.
tone: epic fantasy parody told with total cinematic sincerity; the absurdity of fruit-headed heroes is played straight, humour comes from character and understatement
style_notes: Original dark-fantasy world. Miniature, tactile environments. Fruit heads are photoreal and anatomically integrated. Warm golden palette for home, cold teal for the wild, infernal orange-red for the enemy.

settings.narrator_voice_profile: deep, warm, cinematic trailer narrator with a dry comedic undertone; unhurried, clear diction, lands punchlines with a tiny pause
